question: Can a client pay part of an invoice now and the rest later?
expected_answer: Yes. An invoice can be paid in several parts; it shows Partially paid until the balance is zero, and the client can pay the rest from the portal.
evidence: An invoice can be paid in several parts. Each payment lowers the balance, and the status shows Partially paid until the balance is zero.

question: A client was overcharged on a sent invoice. Is there a way to reduce what they owe without voiding the invoice?
expected_answer: Yes, issue a credit note. It reduces what the client owes without deleting or voiding the invoice, and can be applied to open invoices or kept as credit.
evidence: A credit note reduces what a client owes without deleting or voiding an invoice. Credit note numbers start with CN-.

question: How many files can be attached to one invoice?
expected_answer: Up to 5 files per invoice, each up to 10 MB.
evidence: Attach up to 5 files per invoice, each up to 10 MB. Clients can download them from the email or the portal.

question: If a recurring invoice is paused for two months and then resumed, are the missed invoices sent?
expected_answer: No. Missed dates are not sent; the next invoice goes out on the next scheduled date.
evidence: When you resume, the next invoice goes out on the next scheduled date. Missed dates are not sent.

question: Do webhook events always arrive in the order they happened?
expected_answer: No. Deliveries can arrive more than once and out of order; use the event id to ignore duplicates.
evidence: Deliveries can arrive more than once and out of order. Use the event id to ignore duplicates.

question: How long does it take for a card payment made in the client portal to reach our bank account?
expected_answer: Card payments are settled to your bank account in 2 business days. Bank transfers take 3 to 5 business days.
evidence: Card payments are settled to your bank account in 2 business days. Bank transfers take 3 to 5 business days.

question: An integration got IP-4291. What does that mean?
expected_answer: Too many concurrent requests: more than 10 in flight per API key. It is retryable after Retry-After. It is different from IP-4290, the per-minute limit.
evidence: | 429 | IP-4291 | Too many concurrent requests (more than 10 in flight per key) | Yes, after Retry-After |

question: What does error IP-4223 mean?
expected_answer: The customer is archived (HTTP 422). It is not retryable.
evidence: | 422 | IP-4223 | The customer is archived | No |

question: What does the X-InvoicePilot-Timestamp header contain?
expected_answer: The Unix time the webhook request was signed. Reject requests whose timestamp is more than 5 minutes old.
evidence: | X-InvoicePilot-Timestamp | Unix time the request was signed |

question: Which API call does client.invoices.void make in the Python SDK?
expected_answer: POST /v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/void.
evidence: | client.invoices.void(invoice_id, reason=...) | POST /v2/invoices/{invoice_id}/void |

question: Which version fixed BUG-2110-02?
expected_answer: 2.2.1. BUG-2110-02 rejected expense CSV imports with DD/MM/YYYY dates; it affected 2.1.1.
evidence: This is BUG-2110-02 (Medium). It affected 2.1.1. It was fixed in 2.2.1.

question: Is BUG-2210-01 the same problem as BUG-2210-02?
expected_answer: No. BUG-2210-01 hid the portal Pay now button for partially paid invoices; BUG-2210-02 made POST /v2/payments ignore the Idempotency-Key. Both affected 2.2.1 and were fixed in 2.3.0.
evidence: This is BUG-2210-01 (High). It affected 2.2.1. It was fixed in 2.3.0.
This is BUG-2210-02 (High). It affected 2.2.1. It was fixed in 2.3.0.

question: How many webhook endpoints can a Professional customer create?
expected_answer: 5 webhook endpoints (Enterprise gets 25; Starter has none).
evidence: | Professional | 5 |

question: Can a Starter customer use webhooks?
expected_answer: No. Webhooks are available on Professional (5 endpoints) and Enterprise (25 endpoints) only.
evidence: | Starter | Not available |

question: Does an Enterprise customer get a higher concurrency limit than Starter?
expected_answer: No. The concurrency limit of 10 requests in flight is the same on every plan; only the per-minute limits differ.
evidence: The concurrency limit is the same on every plan. Per-minute limits are 60, 300, or 1,000 by plan.

question: What is the list price per seat for Professional?
expected_answer: $25 per seat per year.
evidence: | Professional | $25 |

question: Can an Enterprise customer get more than 1,000 API requests per minute?
expected_answer: Possibly. Enterprise customers can ask their CSM about a custom limit.
evidence: Higher limits come with a higher plan. Enterprise customers can ask their CSM about a custom limit.

question: How fast should a Professional customer expect a first reply from support?
expected_answer: Email and chat with a first response target of 1 business day.
evidence: | Professional | Email and chat | 1 business day |

question: On 2.2.0, did voiding invoices in bulk also cancel their payment reminders?
expected_answer: No. On 2.2.0 reminders stayed scheduled (BUG-2200-03) and had to be cancelled by hand. Since 2.2.1, a bulk void cancels them.
evidence: - Since 2.2.1, a bulk void cancels reminders automatically.

question: Could a customer on 2.1.1 import expenses with dates written like 31/01/2026?
expected_answer: No. Before 2.2.1 only YYYY-MM-DD worked (BUG-2110-02). DD/MM/YYYY is accepted since 2.2.1.
evidence: Since 2.2.1, dates can be YYYY-MM-DD or DD/MM/YYYY. Before that, only YYYY-MM-DD worked (BUG-2110-02).

question: On 2.0.0, did deleting a draft invoice free up its number?
expected_answer: No. On 2.0.0 deleting a draft left a gap (BUG-2000-04). Since 2.0.1, deleting a draft frees its number.
evidence: On 2.0.0, deleting a draft left a gap in the sequence (BUG-2000-04). Since 2.0.1, deleting a draft frees its number.

question: Why are bulk actions capped at 100 invoices?
expected_answer: Bulk actions run synchronously in the browser request, and 100 invoices keeps the request under 30 seconds.
evidence: Bulk actions run synchronously in the browser request. 100 invoices keeps the request under 30 seconds. An older prototype used 50; some community posts still repeat that number.

question: How many organizations were affected when recurring invoices skipped a cycle at the DST change?
expected_answer: 41 organizations (312 recurring profiles missed one invoice), per postmortem INC-2025-031.
evidence: 312 recurring profiles across 41 organizations missed one invoice.

question: Do sandbox API keys survive the monthly sandbox reset?
expected_answer: Yes. Keys (ip_test_) survive the reset; the data does not.
evidence: The sandbox is wiped at 00:00 UTC on the first day of each month. Keys (ip_test_) survive the reset; data does not.
